meta.title: Sintonia: see how in sync you two are
meta.description: Upload your couple chat history and discover the story, the rhythms and the numbers of the two of you. Everything runs in your browser, no message ever leaves your device.
meta.ogAlt: Sintonia: two waves, one cyan and one magenta, falling into phase. See how in sync you two are.

privacy.title: Privacy comes first
privacy.p2: No message ever leaves your device.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: On your phone, in the chat: ⋮ menu → More → Export chat → Without media. Send the file to yourself (email or Drive), download it on your computer and upload the .txt or .zip here.

telegram.title: Telegram Desktop
telegram.body: On desktop: ⋮ menu → Export chat history. Pick the JSON format and leave all media unchecked, as in the image. Upload the result.json file.
telegram.alt: Telegram Desktop export window with JSON format, all media unchecked, and the range from the oldest message to the present.

consent.body: Sintonia runs only in your browser. There is no account. No message, name, or file is sent to a server. Closing or reloading the tab erases everything.
consent.label: I have read the notice and I declare that I have the right to analyze this chat, with the other person's agreement.
consent.hint: Check this to enable file upload. Do not use a chat you are not part of, or a group chat unless the other people have agreed.

drop.idle: Drag files here or tap to choose
drop.disabled: Check the consent above to upload files

sintonia.explain: Sync measures whether the conversation flows: whether messages get answered, how fast, and in what tone. It does not measure how much you care for each other, only what shows up in this history.
sintonia.short: History too short for a reliable score (at least 3 months and 500 messages).

detail.reciprocity: {pct} of conversations were answered by both sides
detail.tone: {pct} of messages with affection or laughter

sintonia.toneNote: Tone counts words from a list (affection and laughter). It is a simple measure: it does not understand irony or context. Apologies are not part of the score.

balance.explain: Balance measures whether the effort of the conversation is shared: who opens conversations, who sends more messages and words, and who closes. 10 is an even split. A couple can have high sync and low balance: one person leads and the other answers well.
balance.note: A high score does not mean a better relationship: it only shows how evenly the effort is shared.

delete.title: Delete everything
delete.body: Removes files and results from this tab’s memory and also the sessions saved in this browser.
delete.confirmBody: You go back to the start and will need to upload the files again. Sessions saved in this browser will be erased too.

save.title: Save in this browser
save.body: Keeps only the numbers and dates of this report (never the messages) in this browser, along with a code (uuid) that identifies this browser. It is not a cookie and is never sent anywhere. Then, on the upload screen, “Saved sessions” lets you open it again.
save.saved: Saved! It shows up under “Saved sessions” on the upload screen.
save.error: Could not save (the browser blocked storage).
